name: Ashapuri Gold Ornament Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Ashapuri Gold Ornament Ltd is in the business is manufacturing & trading of Gold Ornaments and articles of various designs[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AGOL manufactures antique jewellery and trades in Gold Jewellery of various designs. It was engaged in wholesale trading of Jewellery till March 2019. These jewelleries were manufactured on Job-work basis in Ahmedabad and Rajkot. The design of products is done either in house or by third parties, and manufactured on job work basis. Company has a showroom of 2945 sq. feet at C.G. Road, Ahmedabad.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 91.3% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 42.1 to 25.2 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 7.21% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -14.1%
